name: Avant Foundation Doctor of Medicine Rural Placement Scholarship
summary: Up to $10,000 for final-year Griffith MD students doing a full-year rural clerkship.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident, permanent humanitarian visa holder or New Zealand citizen.
Enrolled in the final year (Phase 3) of the Doctor of Medicine and taking the full-year Longlook rural clerkship.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Students in the Toowoomba end-to-end rural program are excluded.

source.label: Griffith University: Avant Foundation Doctor of Medicine Rural Placement Scholarship

evidence.quote: be enrolled in the final-year (Phase 3) of the Doctor of Medicine (MD) program
